notes.title: 2025 Update [March]
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/c62a1c2abf49583e5727e873ab539583aa50e45b.png[/img]

[b]Geeks 2[/b]: Staying 99 cents, but we will be adding *some sort of* substantial content update to justify the price. As well as a content DLC. 

[b]Scarecrows of Illyria[/b]: The new script and BG patch will probably be hitting before December.

[b]Halloween Retail 4[/b]: Still on track for maybe before late July.

[b]Game #2 2025[/b]: May slip to 2026. We'll see.

[b]Tentacle Prawn DLC[/b]: Possibly December.

tags.feature: - As well as a content DLC.
